title: Heroes' Quest
start: Talk to Achietties at the entrance to the Heroes' Guild in Burthorpe.

requirements.t: 25 Defence (only Black Arm Gang members, you may switch your gang) Questreqstart | no

items.t: Ice gloves (can be obtained during the quest)
Fishing rod (can be obtained during the quest)
Fishing bait if baitless fishing is not unlocked (can be obtained during the quest)
Multiple lockpicks in case of failure, or a hair clip, or master thief's lockpick (tool belt works)
Either one (you may switch your gang):
Black Arm Gang members: black full helm, platebody and platelegs (plateskirt will not work; trimmed armour versions also do not work)
Phoenix Gang members: 1000 coins or ring of charos (a)
For completing the quest with a partner:
Black Arm Gang members: black full helm, platebody and platelegs (plateskirt will not work)
Phoenix Gang members: ranged or magic weapons

recommended.t: Activated Burthorpe, Karamja, Taverley (or Catherby) and Varrock lodestones
Law altar teleport for faster access to Entrana
Dusty key (or level 70 Agility; can be obtained during quest; not required if fishing for lava eels in the Lava Maze) or a Mask of the Black Demon to teleport to Taverley Dungeon

kills.t: Grip (level 21) (only if completing the quest with a partner and only if part of the Phoenix Gang; does not fight back)
Jailer (level 39) (to obtain the dusty key, if required)
Ice Queen (level 77) (to obtain the ice gloves, if not already found)

rewards.t: Ability to wield the dragon battleaxe and dragon mace, and buy them, along with their off-hand variants, from the Happy Heroes' H'emporium shop in the guild
Access to Scarface Pete's mansion in Brimhaven (if you are in the Black Arm Gang)
Access to Cap'n Arnav's garden (if you are in the Phoenix Gang)

steps.t: Talk to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild in Burthorpe. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to Gerrant, the fishing shop owner in Port Sarim, about lava eels. He will give you a vial of blamish snail slime. [Chat: 1 I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.]

sub.t: Buy a fishing rod and fishing bait from Gerrant if you don't already have them.

steps.t: Use the blamish snail slime on your harralander potion (unfinished).
Use the blamish oil on your fishing rod.
Enter Taverley dungeon.
If you already have a dusty key (a steel key ring with the dusty key works), or 70 Agility, skip the next step.
To obtain a dusty key:

sub.t: Use the map (pictured right) to find Velrak the explorer. He is in the southern part of the dungeon.
Kill the Jailer standing by the prison and use the key he drops to get into Velrak's cell.
Talk to him for the dusty key. [Chat: 1 So..do you know anywhere good to explore? › 1 Yes, please!]

steps.t: Enter the area with the blue dragons, either by using your key on the locked door or by taking the Agility shortcut.
Run to the southernmost lava pool.
Catch a lava eel.
Cook the eel on a range or fire.
Go to the Phoenix Gang Hideout in south-east Varrock, down the ladder into the hideout and talk to Straven, learning the gang password from him (Gherkin). Talk to him one more time.
Go to Brimhaven and talk to Alfonse the waiter in the food shop. [Chat: 2 Do you sell...gherkins?]
Go through the door and talk to Charlie the cook. [Chat: 1 I'm looking for a gherkin... › 2 I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.]
Go to the mansion entrance to the west and talk to Garv. Bribe him with 1,000 coins, or free with a ring of charos (a). [Chat: 1 OK]
Enter the front door near the guard.
Go to the north-west part of the building and open the Treasure room door with a lockpick to enter. [Chat: 1 OK]
Open the northern chest.
Search the chest to take one candlestick.
Bring the candlestick back to Straven to receive a Master Thief's Armband.
Go to south-west Varrock and talk to Katrine. [Chat: 1 How can I get a master thief's armband? › Accept]

Go to Brimhaven, to the building east of the bar [Chat: 2 Four-leafed clover] and talk to Trobert. [Chat: 1 So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks? › 1 I volunteer to undertake that mission!]
Equip your Black armour.
Enter the large mansion in the north-west part of town.
Talk to Grip. [Chat: 2 So what do my duties involve?]
Go to the north-west part of the building and open the Treasure room door with a lockpick to enter. [Chat: 1 OK]
Open the northern chest.
Search the chest to take one candlestick.
Bring the candlestick back to Katrine to receive a Master Thief's Armband. [Chat: 1 I have a candlestick now.]
If you do not have ice gloves:

sub.t: Equip combat gear and food to kill a level 77 Ice Queen.
Teleport to Taverley and climb to the top of the White Wolf Mountain and enter the cave.
Mine the rock slide to the east.
Follow the tunnel south-west, then go up the ladder.
Make sure your compass is pointed north and take the east ladder down.
Head north and follow the long tunnel all the way round, then use the ladder at the end.
Take the north ladder back down.
Run north and kill the queen for her gloves.

p: The battle with the Ice Queen
Fishing for the Lava Eel in the Taverley dungeon
Achietties welcomes you into the Heroes' Guild.

steps.t: Bank any equipment (has combat stats).
Sail to Entrana or teleport to the law altar through the Abyss.
Equip the ice gloves.
Kill the Firebird which is located on the northern part of the island, near the law altar, and take the Entranan firebird feather it drops.
Take the feather, eel, and armband to Achietties outside the Heroes' Guild.
Quest complete!

p: A player attacks Grip from behind the wall.
